item.title: MAINTENANCE WORK PLANNED ON AREA ROADWAYS
item.description: Roadwork is taking place on several roadways in Johnson and Saline County next week. According to the Missouri Department of Transportation, crews will not be working on Thursday, January 1, due to the New Year’s Day holiday.
